nature_language: 当前位置深圳。我和我的朋友想去上海玩4天，预算12000人民币，坐飞机去，吃快餐简餐，想去上海迪士尼度假区，住的酒店最好有SPA。
nature_language_en: Current location: Shenzhen. My friend and I want to go to Shanghai for 4 days with a budget of 12,000 RMB. We plan to fly there, eat fast food and simple meals, and we want to visit Shanghai Disney Resort. We prefer a hotel with a spa.
